purpose: User-requested direct risk/return comparison with predictive alternatives, with profitable comparators identified using2021 only.
prior_information: The seven-instrument partial-prediction/control2022–2025 and2026 results are already known. This is a declared exploratory comparison, not a newly untouched confirmatory experiment. No tuning to the known test is allowed.
data_and_execution: Reuse frozen noncrypto daily snapshot,2520-session quarterly train,5-session forward price return,weekly calendar decisions,nextOpen,95% long/cash at predictedreturn>0.003,15bps per side,ex-date dividend credit and split-adjusted fractional units. All labels purged5sessions before quarterly fit.
features: Same predictors for all four supervised models: log price momentum1/5/20/60sessions, logreturn volatility20/60sessions, volume divided by trailing20-session mean. No future values or dividend schedules.

ridge.features: StandardScaler fitted on each train window

svr.features: StandardScaler fitted on each train window

sma50_200.role: Fixed standard trend-direction baseline, existing saved targets

momentum90.role: Fixed standard momentum-direction baseline, existing saved targets

profitability_eligibility: A comparator is validation-profitable only if its initially class-balanced portfolio has net totalreturn>0 and mean actual portfolio exposure>=10% during2021. Eligibility is computed before comparing its test performance. Do not require or select positive testreturn. Save and show all six candidates regardless of eligibility; also show all per-asset results.
portfolio: Initial capital allocated1/15 to each of five equity instruments,1/3TLT,1/3GLD. No inter-asset rebalancing or leverage. Portfolioequity=sum(initialweight*normalizedinstrumentequity), so weights drift with performance; portfolioexposure=value-weighted current exposures. This is an actual self-financing combination of the simulated subaccounts, unlike the earlier mean asset-level ES estimand.
comparators: Direct portfolioES95(partial_prediction)-portfolioES95(each of6candidates), together with netreturn,drawdown,volatility,meanexposure. Buyhold and causal_control remain contextual references, not the focus.
uncertainty: Paired circular bootstrap10000replicates,10sessionblocks with5/20sensitivity; same calendar blocks across all candidates. Bonferroni6 portfolio-comparison intervals, alpha=0.05/6. Per-asset numbers descriptive only. Do not claim significance for observed profitable subsets selected after test.
interpretation: Lower risk with much lower exposure does not establish better timing or a superior risk/return tradeoff. Positive2021 return does not guarantee positive2026 return. Preserve all adverse/negative results and do not choose the winning market or model from test.
stopping: One run of all fixed candidates on all fixed instruments and periods; no model,hyperparameter,feature,threshold,universe or date changes from output.
contextual_control_warmup: In2021 the causal-control reference holds cash until13priorweeklytargets exist; this reference is not among eligibility-selected candidates.
